definitions._written: before any G1-G6 number was computed (verifier, 2026-10-23 KST = date -u + 9 h)
definitions.actual_trajectory: MuJoCo replay of each record (pi05_infer reset with episode / seed / obstacle profile of the record, 1000 warm-up steps, then every recorded control row's applied_ctrl for spa sub-steps, run snapshot of that record). Fidelity = rows whose recorded qpos differs from the replay pre-step qpos (must be 0). All positions are post-step states of the row = measured trajectory.
definitions.apple_frame: origin = GT apple body centre (body 'apple') at the same row; axes = world axes: 앞 = +x (away from the robot), 옆 = +y, 위 = +z; mm

points.fingertip_k: distal face centre of the pad box geom of MJCF finger body ee_finger_l1 (geom 1079) and ee_finger_l2 (geom 1086): geom centre + R_geom[:,i] * size_i * sign, i = geom axis most aligned with the approach axis, sign toward the approach direction. MJCF ee_finger_l1 = URDF ee_finger_l2 and MJCF ee_finger_l2 = URDF ee_finger_l1 (names swapped on the left hand); figures label them by MJCF body + URDF alias
points.pad_k: centre of the same pad geom
points.palm: origin of body EE_BODY_L (MJCF hand base, = URDF ee_left link origin used by the earlier palm-apple numbers)
points.approach_axis: unit vector link_left_arm_6 origin -> EE_BODY_L origin

definitions.close_start: t_close = first control row whose applied left gripper command < 0.5 (also reported: first row < 0.9)

windows.G_rel: t_close - 30 .. t_close + 70 of each record (own close)

definitions.G2_contacts: every sub-step MuJoCo contact (d.contact, collision geoms) with one geom in the active hand (subtree EE_BODY_L + both finger subtrees); partner classes: apple, banana, orange, pear, table (body 'table'), crate, obstacle (obstacle manager geoms), robot_other, other. Per finger body: fingerL1 / fingerL2 / palm (rest of the hand). Per row: sub-steps in contact, min dist, max normal force. first contact t per (hand part, partner). Also apple-banana / apple-table contacts.
definitions.G3_gripper: command = applied_ctrl gripper[0] (1 = open); actual opening = qpos(gripper_finger_l1) / RBY1_GRIPPER_OPEN; finger stop t = first row >= t_close with |opening(t) - opening(t-1)| < 0.005 for 3 consecutive rows; blocked = at the stop row opening - command > 0.05; blocking partner = partners in contact with either finger subtree at the stop row (and 2 rows around)
definitions.G4_apple: GT apple centre displacement from its position at t_close - 10: |d| 3D, xy, z per row; roll = rotation angle of the apple quaternion vs t_close - 10 (deg)
definitions.G5_server: per request k (planning row) of the two AG3S records: TrajOpt edit = max over executed rows 0-7 of |FK_tip_mid(refined row) - FK_tip_mid(reference row)| and |FK_tcp ...| (FK on the replay state at the chunk start row with the left arm 7 joints and the gripper of the row; mm); executed source = which of reference / refined is closer to the client applied_ctrl arm rows (max abs rad); HOLD = exec_feedback n_hold of the next request / client hold rows; grasp state / transition / attach / detach / rejected / attach_revoked / evidence.checks / note; subtask p(pick); tip_alignment now / plan_close d3
definitions.G6_plan: per request k: VLA chunk before TrajOpt (server reference_chunk for the AG3S records, traj.npz predicted_chunks for VLA 단독; equality of predicted_chunks vs reference_chunk checked) -> first row with left gripper < 0.5 = planned close row; FK (replay state at the chunk start row, left arm joints + gripper of that row) -> planned tip_mid and palm in the apple frame of the chunk start row; requests skipped when no close row

cause_criteria.a: TRUE if in [t_close - 10, t_stop] the first contact of a finger subtree is with a non-apple partner (banana / orange / pear / table / crate / obstacle / other), or the fingers are blocked (G3) with a non-apple partner in contact at the stop row
cause_criteria.b: TRUE if GT apple centre moves >= 10 mm (3D) from t_close - 10 within [t_close - 10, t_close + 40] AND >= 1 hand-apple contact row in that window
cause_criteria.c: TRUE if for the request whose executed rows contain t_close the VLA planned close-row tip_mid - apple centre distance (3D) exceeds the VLA 단독 value (its own close request) by >= 20 mm; also reported: planned tip_mid in the apple frame for all three
cause_criteria.d: TRUE if in a request whose executed rows overlap [t_close, t_stop] the TrajOpt edit of tip_mid (refined vs reference, executed rows) is >= 10 mm, or a HOLD row lies in [t_close, t_stop], or the executed chunk is the refined one and the actual tip_mid moves >= 10 mm relative to the apple frame during [t_close, t_stop]
cause_criteria.d_note: the last clause alone (actual motion) does not mark (d) without the refined chunk being executed
cause_criteria.e: TRUE if after t_close there is a request with physical grasp evidence (both finger subtrees in contact with the apple in >= 3 consecutive rows) whose grasp state is not attached / held, followed within 3 requests by a HOLD or a TrajOpt tip_mid edit >= 10 mm; or attach_revoked / rejected after t_close followed by a HOLD; or the applied gripper command differs from the VLA chunk gripper by > 0.1 in [t_close, t_close + 40]
cause_criteria.f: TRUE if none of a-e is TRUE; reported facts: closed opening at t_stop, tip_mid - apple at t_close and t_stop, finger pad - apple geom distance at t_stop
